fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Osmotic Flux with Concentration Polarization
description: 0D lumped FO module. Water flux Jw = A*(pi_draw_eff - pi_feed_eff) driven by osmotic pressure only (no hydraulic pressure). Internal (ICP) + external (ECP) concentration polarization reduce effective driving force; reverse salt flux Js dilutes draw and salts feed. solve_ivp integrates draw-tank concentration/volume.
source: McCutcheon & Elimelech (2006) J. Membr. Sci. 284:237-247 (ICP/ECP flux model); Cath, Childress & Elimelech (2006) J. Membr. Sci. 281:70-87 (FO review); McGinnis & Elimelech (2008) Environ. Sci. Technol. 42:8625 (draw regeneration energy)

unit.name: Thin-film composite FO module (TFC-ES class), NaCl draw

A_perm.note: Water permeability coefficient at 25C (TFC-ES: 1-2 LMH/bar) — McCutcheon 2006

k_ecp.note: External concentration polarization mass-transfer coefficient (draw-side, dilutive ECP)

S_structural_m.note: Membrane structural parameter S = t*tau/eps (~400 um, TFC-ES) — controls ICP

i_vant_hoff.note: van't Hoff dissociation factor for NaCl (Na+ + Cl-)

phi_osmotic.note: Osmotic coefficient for NaCl at seawater concentration

c_draw0_mol_m3.note: Initial draw molar concentration (1 M NaCl ~ 1000 mol/m3 ~ 58.4 g/L)

c_feed_mol_m3.note: Feed-water concentration held constant (brackish ~1 g/L NaCl)

SEC_regen_kWh_m3.note: Draw reconcentration specific energy (RO/thermal regen) — McGinnis 2008
